title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 23, 2026 at 15:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 403 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Earth looks nice from up here. 🌎💫✨

A few bright active regions and broad dark coronal structures stand out today, while the overall solar disk remains relatively quiet.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211/193/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
